title: What Is a Black Hole, Really?
post_title: What Is a Black Hole, Really? | QuantaTale
post_description: Black holes are not holes at all. Here is what they really are. Sources: National Aeronautics and Space Administration https://science.nasa.gov/universe/black-holes/ and European Space Agency https://www.esa.int/articles/about-us/directorates/science/black-holes #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: What kind of thing is so heavy that even light can't get out? Black holes aren't really holes at all. They're huge amounts of stuff squeezed into very tiny spaces. Their gravity is so strong that light itself stays trapped. One kind is born when a giant star runs out of fuel and blows up. Since they give off no light, we spot them by how they tug on things nearby. A telescope has even pictured a dark shape against the glow around one.
